rationale.en: “{answer}” is the form the sentence requires: needn't / need not = no obligation, mustn't = prohibition, didn't need to = it wasn't necessary, needn't have done = it was done but pointless, and need + -ing / need only + bare verb follow their own fixed patterns.
rationale.ru: «Это “{answer}”» — нужная форма: needn't / need not = нет обязанности, mustn't = запрет, didn't need to = не было необходимости, needn't have done = сделано, но зря, а need + -ing / need only + голый глагол идут по своим устойчивым моделям.
